jobs.title: Senior Planning Officer (Career Grade)
jobs.description:
### **About The Role**


This is a career graded planner role. The salary starts on **£33,672 \- £37,562** at band 6 graduate level, progressing to **£38,510 \- £42,123** at band 7 Planning Officer level, and up to **£43,150 \- £47,664** at band 8 Senior Planning Officer level. An additional market supplement of £3,500 per annum is applicable at the Senior level (Band 8\) only, reviewed yearly.



This is a fantastic opportunity to build a career as a planner with the Borough of Great Yarmouth. Located on the east coast of Norfolk, the Borough benefits from over 15 miles of coastline, a strong visitor economy, a growing offshore energy and port logistics sector, and the distinctive seaside towns of Great Yarmouth and Gorleston\-on\-Sea.



The Council is delivering an ambitious regeneration programme, with major projects including North Quay, South Denes, and the Winter Gardens, building on the successful transformation of The Venetian Waterways and the Market Place. The Borough’s unique landscape and constraints require a carefully balanced approach to growth and addressing impacts associated with climate change, flood risk, and deprivation. The new Local Plan sets out a clear vision to deliver 6,840 new homes by 2042 alongside employment opportunities and supporting infrastructure.



The role offers genuine scope to influence development across the Borough, including opportunities to present at planning committee. In addition to a competitive salary, the Council provides an attractive benefits package, including generous annual leave, flexible working arrangements, and access to a quality pension scheme.



End date: 20th September 2026



Interview date: 30th September 2026



For more information, or to discuss this role, please contact Rob Tate, via email at rob.tate@great\-yarmouth.gov.uk or 01493 846854\.

### **About You**



If you have a strong background in town planning or a related discipline such as geography or economics, this role will appeal to you. We are seeking motivated individuals who are keen to shape development, possess strong report‑writing skills, and communicate clearly and confidently. The Council is committed to supporting continuous professional development, including opportunities to gain membership of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI). The team receives an extensive variety of applications to support career development. Applicants are encouraged to review the full job description and person specification for further details about the role.



At Band 6 (graduate) level, candidates will have a Bachelor’s Degree (or similar) in Town and Country Planning or a related discipline with the ability to organise and prioritise their own work, and to write reports with a high level of verbal logic. At Band 7 (officer) level, candidates will have a Masters Degree or equivalent in Town and Country Planning accredited by the Royal Town Planning Institute, and evidence towards chartered membership. At Band 8 (senior) level, candidates will have a Masters Degree or equivalent in Town and Country Planning and full chartered membership of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) with at least five years’ experience of planning policy or development management related work, or significant demonstrable experience of working at a senior level.

### **About Us**



Great Yarmouth Borough Council has the goal to achieve excellence for the Borough. We don’t just say we are ambitious; we mean it. We are always looking at the ways in which we can improve and be the best that we can, providing the best for the people who live, work, visit and operate businesses in the Borough.



We have big plans for the future and massive opportunities ahead. We are one of the most successful enterprise zones in the country, Great Yarmouth is England’s offshore energy hub and Norfolk’s biggest seaside resort at the edge of the Broads National Park. The challenges we face in the borough are wide, but our commitment to achieving more has never been so focused.



We know that our team members are our most valuable asset, working hard to achieve our short and long term goals. Find out more about the people who work with us, and if you are as ambitious as we are, apply now and be part of our team.



We offer a range of exciting benefits as an employer and are committed to a policy of equal opportunity in employment and the services we provide.



There is more information on the Jobs page of the Great Yarmouth Borough Website, with details of how to apply and the recruitment process. You will also be able to find more details regarding DBS checks (if relevant for the job role), Right to Work checks, along with details of our values and behaviours, agile working and our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Planning Policy Technician
jobs.description:
We are an ambitious Council, always trying to improve the many public services that we provide to our residents. Even more importantly, we aim to help preserve and enhance Waverley’s beautiful and precious environment and make a positive impact on the lives of everybody who lives or works here in Waverley.


**About the Role**



This is an exciting opportunity to join a friendly, high performing planning policy team. The post holder will provide technical and administrative support to the team preparing a new local plan for the Borough and assisting communities with their neighbourhood plans.



On the job training will be given and the role could be a step on to a planning career



This is an agile post which allows the holder to work from home after an initial period of induction at the discretion of their line manager depending on the business needs of the service.



This post is advertised as a full\-time role. However, all applications will be considered.


**About You**



To be successful in this interesting and varied role, you will need to be methodical and organised, be competent in the use of IT and committed to customer care. An interest in planning and experience in using GIS will also be useful.


**What We Offer**



In return for your valued contribution, we offer a competitive benefits package which includes:


* Hybrid and agile working policies


* Training and development opportunities including apprenticeships


* Generous annual leave and flexi time


* An employee assistance programme


* Membership of the Local Government Pension Scheme



You can find out more about working at Waverley and our benefits by visiting: Jobs \| Waverley Borough Council


**Ready to join us?**



Apply now and help shape the future of Waverley. For an informal discussion about the post, please contact Olivia Gorham, Principal Planning Officer (Policy) on 523099 or Matthew Ellis, Planning Policy Team Leader on 01483 523297



We do not accept CVs without a completed application form. Strictly no agencies please.



The closing date for application is 9am on the 5th October 2026 and we anticipate interviews being held in person in Godalming on 20th October 2026\.


**Equality and Inclusion Statement**



The district is home to many different people, and we want our workforce to reflect our diverse local communities. We encourage and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences – we are a Disability Confident employer and appoint on merit. You can find out more about this scheme and check your eligibility here \- Working at Waverley Borough Council \| Waverley Borough Council



We are proud to have signed the Armed Forces Covenant and welcome applications from serving or ex\-members of the armed forces and their partners. We offer an interview scheme for serving and ex\-military forces members when they meet the essential criteria for the role. You can find out more about this scheme and check your eligibility here \- Working at Waverley Borough Council \| Waverley Borough Council



Please note we do not accept applications after the stated closing time.



Right to work in the UK will be checked as part of the interview process.


**Information**



We understand that some applicants may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist with preparing their applications.



All submitted information, whether supported by AI or not, must accurately reflect the applicant’s own skills, experience, and qualifications.



Recruitment decisions will be based on how well applicants demonstrate these attributes during the interview and selection process.



From April 2027, Guildford Borough Council and Waverley Borough Council will become part of the new West Surrey unitary council, following the government’s confirmed plans for local government reorganisation across Surrey. This change will see the current twelve councils replaced by two new authorities, East Surrey and West Surrey, with West Surrey taking responsibility for the areas currently served by Guildford, Waverley, Runnymede, Spelthorne, Surrey Heath and Woking.



As we move towards this transition, our focus remains firmly on delivering high‑quality, value‑for‑money services and staying true to our shared organisational values of Collaboration, Wellbeing, Trusted, Value for Money and Professionalism.



We recognise that any period of organisational change can bring questions, particularly regarding future structures and working arrangements. Throughout this process, we are committed to supporting our colleagues with transparency and care prioritising wellbeing, maintaining a trusted and open dialogue, and ensuring continued access to learning and professional development opportunities.



While the exact shape of the new West Surrey Council beyond 2027 is still being developed, joining us now means becoming part of an organisation where collaboration thrives and where your contribution will directly influence one of the most significant local government transformations in decades. You’ll gain valuable experience, play an active role in shaping the future of public services across West Surrey, and work within a team committed to professionalism and delivering outstanding outcomes for our communities.



Together, we will ensure a smooth transition and continue to deliver exceptional services for residents both now and into the future.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
#### **Role Overview**


The Customer Success Manager is responsible for building strong long\-term relationships with customers and ensuring they achieve ongoing value from the platform. The CSM becomes the primary point of contact once onboarding is complete, supporting operational use, planning future activity, identifying opportunities for improvement, and managing renewals. This role is central to customer satisfaction, retention, and account growth.


**Location:** Hybrid \| **Reports to:** Director, Customer Experience


#### **Key Responsibilities**


#### **Handover \& Transition Management**


* Attend the sales\-to\-service handover to understand customer context, goals, and scope.
* Participate in onboarding kickoff sessions as required to gain clarity on timelines and early deliverables.
* Lead the BAU handover process from delivery into Customer Success, ensuring all relevant information, risks, and dependencies are captured.
* Build a strong understanding of the customer's exam schedule, workflows, and operating model.

#### **Customer Relationship Ownership**


* Act as the main point of contact once onboarding is complete.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer goals and ensure the solution supports these effectively.
* Build productive relationships with key customer stakeholders.
* Conduct regular check\-ins, including monthly, quarterly, or six\-monthly cadence depending on the customer’s engagement model.

#### **Governance \& Strategic Planning**


* Lead BAU governance meetings, offering clear updates, insights, and recommendations.
* Run Quarterly or 6\-Monthly Customer Success reviews to track progress, discuss improvements, and support long\-term planning.
* Help customers prepare for future exam cycles using previous performance and lessons learned.

#### **Operational Support \& Coordination**


* Coordinate with internal teams including Onboarding Specialists, L2 Support, Operations, and PMO when customer issues or questions arise.
* Participate in pre\-exam day meetings where needed to ensure customer readiness.
* Help customers prepare for future exam cycles using previous performance and lessons learned.
* Track and escalate risks to ensure a smooth customer experience.

#### **Performance \& Adoption Tracking**


* Monitor customer usage, success metrics, and exam activity to identify risks or opportunities.
* Analyse trends and help customers improve efficiency, quality, and overall satisfaction.
* Ensure customers adopt new features and understand the full value of the platform.

#### **Renewals \& Growth**


* Own the renewal process, ensuring timely and structured communication.
* Identify upsell opportunities based on customer goals, platform usage, and future plans.
* Support commercial conversations in partnership with Sales where needed.
* Maintain accurate account notes and forecasting for renewals and risk.

#### **Requirements**


* Experience in a Customer Success, Account Management, or relationship\-focused role within a SaaS or technology environment.
* Strong communication skills with the confidence to speak to senior stakeholders and guide strategic conversations.
* Ability to analyse data, identify trends, and provide insight that supports decision\-making.
* Experience handling escalations and working with cross\-functional teams to resolve issues.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple customers at once.

#### **Desirable**


* Familiarity with exam delivery, assessment technologies, or regulated operational environments.
* Experience working with onboarding or implementation teams.
* Understanding of customer lifecycles and success planning frameworks.
* Experience managing renewals or supporting commercial discussions.

#### **What We Offer**


* An opportunity to shape the direction of a fast\-growing EdTech company.
* A collaborative, respectful, and innovative working culture.
* Competitive salary and benefits package (Pension/Health Care etc).
* Hybrid working environment, one day a week on site.
* Flexible working arrangements.
* Competitive family leave.

### **About TestReach**


TestReach is an award\-winning technology company headquartered at NexusUCD in Dublin, Ireland. Co\-founded by Louella Morton and Sheena Bailey in 2014, and now employing 200\+ staff, TestReach provides innovative solutions for the online creation, management, and delivery of examinations. TestReach covers the end\-to\-end assessment process, from initial question development right through to detailed results and data analysis. The TestReach solution includes the integral option of live remote invigilation for formal exams, where the candidate is monitored in real\-time online by trained TestReach supervisors using video, audio, and remote screen share technology. With TestReach, examining bodies can create engaging assessments using the advanced test authoring tool and then roll them out securely, anywhere in the world, at any time, for any number of candidates, while maintaining the full integrity of the test.


At TestReach we are proud to champion gender equality in the workplace. You can view a report on our gender balance and gender pay gap at the following link: Gender Pay Gap TestReach
